mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart ( product_id, user_id, created_at, created_by ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{userId}, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT c.cart_id, c.product_id, p.product_name, p.category_id, p.category_name, p.price, p.shipping_price, p.images FROM cart c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.product_id WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT ci.cart_item_id, ci.cart_id, ci.quantity, ci.product_option_id, po.product_id, po.option_name, po.option_price, po.is_required, po.is_quantity_adjustable FROM cart_item ci LEFT JOIN product_option po ON ci.product_option_id = po.product_option_id WHERE ci.cart_id = #{cartId} ORDER BY po.is_required DESC, po.option_name
